description: This module provides user management for ejabberd servers.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The ejabberd host associated with this username.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password to assign to the username.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Describe the desired state of the user to be managed. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The name of the user to manage.

examples:
# Example playbook entries using the ejabberd_user module to manage users state.

- name: Create a user if it does not exist
  community.general.ejabberd_user:
    username: test
    host: server
    password: password

- name: Delete a user if it exists
  community.general.ejabberd_user:
    username: test
    host: server
    state: absent
